insights.label: Manon Fiorot vs orthodox opponents
insights.explanation: Manon Fiorot is 8-1-0 in 9 UFC bouts against orthodox opponents (3 KO/TKO, 0 submission, 5 decision wins), PBE-derived from canonical results as of 2026-09-14.

stance_finish_rate.note: finish_rate MetricObject of the split must itself be >= low (registry min 2 wins)

meta.as_of_semantics: as_of_date is exclusive: the snapshot dated D contains bouts with event_date < D, so a bout fought on D is excluded by the snapshot dated D. ?as_of=D resolves to the latest stored snapshot with as_of_date <= D, which therefore never contains a bout fought on or after D.
